coverage_explanation: Exercises both range endpoints, each individual bit, complementary mixed-bit patterns, and return to zero. Every LED is checked after every input, verifying both illumination and clearing of previous bits. Output modes are also checked.
assumptions: The supplied circuit makes all five LEDs active HIGH; no bench wiring defaults are needed.
Decimal numbers followed by newline are valid under the supplied line_or_idle serial framing at 9600 baud.
No initial LED pattern is specified, so checks begin only after an explicit number is received.
A 300 ms settling allowance is used because no precise response deadline is specified.
